many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

cat > programs/task-3721504e.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    """Intersect the two masks separated by a central horizontal divider."""
    h = len(grid)
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and r == h - r - 1:
            top, bottom = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
            return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(top_row, bottom_row)]
                    for top_row, bottom_row in zip(top, bottom)]
    raise ValueError('No central horizontal divider')
PY
